reasons: The inserted paragraph supplies every atomic preferred element: professional and workmanlike services standard, express documentation conformance for software/deliverables (12 months) and services (90 days), malicious code, compliance with laws, and repair/replacement/refund remedy.
Fallback is not satisfied on its own numeric terms (12 months and 90 days rather than 90/30 days), but that is more protective for the Customer and the locked target is preferred.
Minimal: a single concise insertion addressing an absent performance warranty; the Y2K warranty, access/repair mechanic and disclaimer paragraph are untouched.

No undefined terms or contradictions introduced; 'Support Services', 'Hosting Services', 'Interface' are existing agreement terms and the express warranty carve-out in the disclaimer ('EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT') preserves the new warranties.
